scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @stockpot/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev -w @stockpot/api" "npm start -w @stockpot/web"
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @stockpot/web
